description: Presets for the video demo (video.render.html) — one per distinct attribute combo found in video.html. Furniture tokens (chip/play/ply) are appended by the renderer from card content and never live here.

video-frame.name: Video Frame Preset
video-frame.description: Bare <ui-media> 16:9 frame with large radius — native <video controls>

video-frame-tools.name: Video Frame Tools Preset
video-frame-tools.description: Bare <ui-media> 16:9 frame with fullscreen + picture-in-picture player tools — chrome-less <video> driven by <ui-play>

video-stack.name: Video Stack Preset
video-stack.description: Column card, 16:9 media, padded content — YouTube/Vimeo embed cards

video-split.name: Video Split Preset
video-split.description: Full-width split card — video left, content right at lg, stacking on mobile; fullscreen + PiP tools

video-split-reverse.name: Video Split Reverse Preset
video-split-reverse.description: Mirrored split card — content left, video right at lg; fullscreen + PiP tools

video-overlay.name: Video Overlay Preset
video-overlay.description: Cinematic 21:9 overlay card — content bottom-left over a scrim

video-tile.name: Video Tile Preset
video-tile.description: Bare square <ui-media> tile with medium radius — archive/gallery embed grids
